XRPUSD jumped about 8% after Ripple said asset managers and commercial projects plan near-term XRPL adoption, sparking a notable intraday price rise for the pair.
On-chain data shows large holders accumulating XRPUSD; URPD finds limited realized resistance below $1.60 and about 2.5 billion XRP traded near the $1.60 level.
Options-implied one‑standard‑deviation move for XRPUSD is about 8.9% through Sept 27, implying a downside near $1.37 and upside near $1.64 from a $1.51 spot, signaling premium for volatility.
Sept 11–17: Binance saw average daily XRPUSD inflows of 21.7M (≈663% above quarterly baseline) and outflows of 11.6M, while total Binance XRP reserves rose ~0.22% to ~2.63B.
Veteran trader Peter Brandt charted a long-term XRPUSD target at $5.40 using monthly trend channels and moving averages, noting XRP must reverse its correction and reclaim key technical levels first.
XRPL Permission Delegation v1.1 began a two‑week activation window on Sep 21, 2026; earliest activation Oct 5, 2026 11:18 UTC. Network needs >80% sustained support; ≤80% rejects amendment.
XRP Ledger v1.1 upgrade enables linked asset and payment transfers to settle as one unit. Ripple says commercial projects are in development; more details due after the upgrade goes live.
